annotations.title: Replace paid SaaS with open source: savings and payback

description: Give monthly spend per paid tool (ids: mixpanel, semrush, freshbooks, calendly, chargebee, typeform, pipedrive, gohighlevel, intercom). Returns the open-source swap for each (repo, license, caveat), yearly savings after hosting, setup hours and cost, break-even months, and a SWITCH / MAYBE / KEEP verdict.

hostingPerMonth.description: Estimated monthly server cost to self-host. Default 20.

hourlyRate.description: Value of an hour of setup time. Default 50.

spend.description: Map of tool id to monthly spend in dollars, e.g. {"mixpanel": 300, "intercom": 150}.

name: saas_self_host_savings
